title: Deterministic state evolution
scientific_source: User-defined explanatory example: dx/dt = -x, solution x(t) = x(0) exp(-t). No experimental data.
mechanism: Show a deterministic ODE mapping distinct initial states toward equilibrium over increasing time.
must_show: A unique nonbranching trajectory for each initial state
must_not_show: Trajectories meeting at finite time: nonzero initial states remain nonzero at t=1
Nonmonotone or U-shaped trajectories: dx/dt=-x approaches zero monotonically
